requirement:
修复用户信息修改功能的 bug。
用户修改个人信息后，认证服务没有同步更新。
需要检查用户服务和认证服务之间的数据同步逻辑。

details.name: ts-auth-service
details.rationale: Auth service must sync user data updates; requirement explicitly mentions it not updating after user changes.

details.name: ts-admin-user-service
details.rationale: Admin user management may also modify user profiles and could be affected by sync logic changes.

details.name: ts-contacts-service
details.rationale: Contacts service may rely on user data consistency, but less directly tied to auth sync.

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: Notifications might be triggered on profile changes, but no direct dependency on auth sync.
